fields.name: tabLabel
fields.label: Tab Label
fields.description: The label of the tab. Consecutive Tab sections form one set of tabs.

fields.name: activeTab
fields.label: Active tab
fields.description: Shows this tab when the page loads (the first tab if no tab of the set is active).

fields.name: anchorName
fields.label: ID
fields.description: Links to #ID open this tab (deep link), also from Anchor List, e.g. overview (lowercase, no spaces).

fields.name: tabsAriaLabel
fields.label: Accessibility label
fields.description: Names the set of tabs for screen readers, e.g. Our services. Read from the first tab of the set.
